shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.description: Publish your priced DiveDay rental and package catalog as Shopify products.
shopify.domainDescription: Use the store's myshopify.com domain. DiveDay only asks for product write access.
shopify.syncDescription: Only priced rentals and active dive packages are sent. Products are tagged as managed by DiveDay.
shopify.notConnected: No Shopify store is connected yet.

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks Online
quickbooks.description: Write paid orders and refunds as idempotent SalesReceipts and RefundReceipts.
quickbooks.incomeAccountDescription: The QuickBooks income account used by the DiveDay sales item. Find its numeric ID in QuickBooks.
quickbooks.notConnected: No QuickBooks company is connected yet.
quickbooks.setupRequired: Connect a company and set its income account before paid orders can sync.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.description: Send selected order events to a Zapier Webhooks by Zapier Catch Hook.
zapier.webhookDescription: Treat this URL like a password. It is sealed in DiveDay and never shown again after saving.
zapier.notConnected: No Zapier Catch Hook is connected yet.
zapier.eventsDescription: Choose which order events this Zap should receive.
